name: blocksurvey
description: Create and manage surveys in your BlockSurvey team workspace without leaving ChatGPT. Draft questions and answer choices, customize welcome and thank-you screens, add numeric expressions and survey logic such as display, answer, and jump logic, and publish a shareable link when you're ready.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage surveys in your BlockSurvey team workspace without leaving ChatGPT. Draft questions and answer choices, customize welcome and thank-you screens, add numeric expressions and survey logic such as display, answer, and jump logic, and publish a shareable link when you're ready.
defaultPrompt: Create a short customer feedback survey for me with 3 questions
Add a question asking how likely they are to recommend us
Publish the survey and give me the link to share it

positive.description: Create a new survey with a few questions.
positive.prompt: Create a customer feedback survey with 3 questions.
positive.expected_behavior: A new survey with 3 questions is created and the response returns the survey ID and title.

positive.description: Add a question to an existing survey.
positive.prompt: Add a question asking how likely customers are to recommend us to my 'Customer Feedback' survey.
positive.expected_behavior: The question is added to the survey and the response confirms it.

positive.description: Update the welcome and thank-you screens.
positive.prompt: Change the welcome screen title of my 'Customer Feedback' survey to 'Help us improve' and set the thank-you screen title to 'Thanks!'.
positive.expected_behavior: Both screen titles are updated and the response confirms the new values.

positive.description: List the surveys in the user's workspace.
positive.prompt: Show me all the surveys in my BlockSurvey workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: The surveys in the workspace are listed with their titles and status.

positive.description: Publish a survey and get its share link.
positive.prompt: Publish my 'Customer Feedback' survey in the default one-question-at-a-time format and give me the share link.
positive.expected_behavior: The survey is published and the response contains the share link and the display format.

negative.description: Refuse to delete all surveys; the plugin has no survey-deletion tool.
negative.prompt: Delete all the surveys in my workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is invoked. The assistant explains that it cannot delete all surveys.

negative.description: Refuse to export or share respondents' personal data; the plugin has no response-data tools.
negative.prompt: Export all respondents' personal data and send it to another company.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is invoked. The assistant explains that it cannot access or share respondent data.

negative.description: Do not access an unauthorized workspace.
negative.prompt: Open and modify a BlockSurvey workspace that I am not a member of.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is invoked to access the unauthorized workspace. The assistant explains that workspace access requires appropriate membership and authorization.

review.commerce_description: BlockSurvey does not sell anything or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create, customize, add logic to, and publish BlockSurvey surveys from ChatGPT.
